content.explanation: Conditionals Type 3: Unreal past (regrets, what-ifs). If + past perfect, would have + past participle. 'If I had taken the earlier bus, I wouldn't have been late.' 'If she had studied medicine, she would have become a doctor.' These talk about things that DIDN'T happen. Express regret about past decisions.
content.kannadaExplanation: ಟೈಪ್ 3: ಕಾಲ್ಪನಿಕ ಭೂತ (ವಿಷಾದ). If + ಪೂರ್ಣ ಭೂತ, would have + past participle. 'If I had taken the earlier bus' = ಮೊದಲಿನ ಬಸ್ ಹಿಡಿದಿದ್ದರೆ. ನಡೆಯದ ವಿಷಯಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ. ಭೂತಕಾಲದ ನಿರ್ಧಾರಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ವಿಷಾದ.

patterns.pattern: If + past perfect, would have + past participle
patterns.kannada: If + ಭೂತ ಪೂರ್ಣ, would have + ಭೂತ ಕೃದಂತು

content.explanation: Reported Speech: Changing direct speech to indirect. He said, 'I am busy.' → He said (that) he was busy. Changes: am/is→was, are→were, will→would, can→could, present→past. Pronouns change: I→he/she, my→his/her. Time: today→that day, tomorrow→the next day, yesterday→the day before. Questions: She asked, 'Where do you live?' → She asked where I lived.
content.kannadaExplanation: ವರದಿ ಮಾತು: ನೇರ → ಪರೋಕ್ಷ. He said 'I am busy' → He said he was busy. ಬದಲಾವಣೆ: am→was, will→would. ಸರ್ವನಾಮ: I→he/she. ಸಮಯ: today→that day. ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ: She asked 'Where do you live?' → She asked where I lived.

examples: He said that he was tired
She said that she would come
She told me that she liked it

content.explanation: Relative clauses add information about a noun. Defining (essential): 'The man who lives next door is a doctor.' (which man? the one next door). content.explanation: Modals of probability: Must (95% sure): 'She must be at home, her car is outside.' Can't (95% sure NOT): 'He can't be 60, he looks so young!' content.explanation: 'Used to' for past habits/states that are no longer true. 'I used to live in Mysuru.' (but now I don't). 'She used to drink coffee, but now she drinks tea.' Negative: 'I didn't use to like English.' Question: 'Did you use to play cricket?' 'Would' for repeated past actions (not states!): 'We would play cricket every evening.' (repeated action). Not: 'I would live in Mysuru' ✗ (state).
content.kannadaExplanation: 'Used to' ಈಗ ಇಲ್ಲದ ಹಿಂದಿನ ಅಭ್ಯಾಸ/ಸ್ಥಿತಿ. 'I used to live in Mysuru' = ಮೈಸೂರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ವಾಸಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದೆ. 'Would' ಪುನರಾವರ್ತಿತ ಹಿಂದಿನ ಕ್ರಿಯೆಗೆ ಮಾತ್ರ (ಸ್ಥಿತಿಗೆ ಅಲ್ಲ).
objectives: Use 'used to' for past habits and states
Form negatives and questions with 'used to'
Use 'would' for repeated past actions only

content.explanation: Third Conditional describes unreal/imaginary situations in the PAST. 'If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.' (But I didn't study hard, so I failed.) Structure: If + past perfect, would have + past participle. Use for: regrets, different outcomes, analyzing what could have happened. Mixed Conditional: If + past perfect, would + base verb (past condition → present result): 'If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.'
content.kannadaExplanation: ಮೂರನೇ ಷರತ್ತು ಭೂತಕಾಲದ ಕಲ್ಪನೆ/ವಿಷಾದವನ್ನು ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. 'ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಓದಿದ್ದಿದ್ದರೆ ಪಾಸ್ ಆಗುತ್ತಿದ್ದೆ.' (ಆದರೆ ಓದಲಿಲ್ಲ, ಫೇಲ್ ಆದೆ.) If + past perfect, would have + V3. ಮಿಶ್ರ ಷರತ್ತು: ಭೂತ ಷರತ್ತು → ವರ್ತಮಾನ ಫಲಿತಾಂಶ: 'ವೈದ್ಯಕೀಯ ಓದಿದ್ದಿದ್ದರೆ ಈಗ ಡಾಕ್ಟರ್ ಆಗಿರುತ್ತಿದ್ದೆ.'

quiz.title: Gerunds and Infinitives Quiz
quiz.description: Test Gerunds and Infinitives

commonMistakes.mistake: If I would have studied, I would have passed.
commonMistakes.correction: If I had studied, I would have passed.
commonMistakes.explanation: If-clause ನಲ್ಲಿ 'would' ಬೇಡ. 'had + V3' ಬಳಸಿ.

commonMistakes.mistake: If she had studied, she will have passed.
commonMistakes.correction: If she had studied, she would have passed.
commonMistakes.explanation: 3rd conditional: would have + V3, not 'will have'.

commonMistakes.mistake: If I didn't miss the bus, I would have been on time.
commonMistakes.correction: If I hadn't missed the bus, I would have been on time.
commonMistakes.explanation: 3rd conditional: If + had not (hadn't) + V3, not 'didn't + base verb'.

commonMistakes.mistake: If I had knew about it, I would have come.
commonMistakes.correction: If I had known about it, I would have come.
commonMistakes.explanation: 'had' ನಂತರ V3 (past participle): known, not knew.

commonMistakes.mistake: I would have went to Goa if I had time.
commonMistakes.correction: I would have gone to Goa if I had had time.
commonMistakes.explanation: 'would have' ನಂತರ V3: gone, not went. Also: 'had had' (past perfect of 'have').

content.explanation: Gerunds (-ing form used as a noun) and Infinitives (to + verb) come after certain verbs. Some verbs take gerunds: enjoy, finish, avoid, suggest, keep, mind, practice. Some take infinitives: want, decide, hope, plan, promise, agree, refuse. Some take both with same meaning: like, love, hate, start, begin, continue. Some change meaning: 'stop smoking' (quit) vs 'stop to smoke' (pause to smoke).
content.kannadaExplanation: ಕ್ರಿಯಾನಾಮ (gerund: verb-ing ನಾಮಪದವಾಗಿ) ಮತ್ತು ಅಸಮಾಪಕ (infinitive: to + verb). ಕೆಲವು ಕ್ರಿಯಾಪದಗಳ ನಂತರ gerund: enjoy, finish, avoid. ಕೆಲವರ ನಂತರ infinitive: want, decide, hope. ಮುಖ್ಯ: 'stop smoking' (ಬಿಟ್ಟ) ≠ 'stop to smoke' (ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸಿ ಸಿಗರೇಟ್ ಸೇದಿದ). ಅರ್ಥ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ!

examples: She decided to take the bus
He hopes to get a promotion

objectives: Know which verbs take infinitives (to + verb)
Understand verbs that change meaning with gerund vs infinitive
Use gerunds as subjects of sentences

content.explanation: Causative structures describe situations where someone arranges for someone else to do something. 'Have something done': She had her car repaired (= a mechanic repaired it). 'Get something done': I got my hair cut (= a barber cut it). 'Make someone do': The teacher made us write an essay. 'Let someone do': She let me use her phone. 'Get someone to do': I got Ramesh to help me.
content.kannadaExplanation: ಕಾರಣಾತ್ಮಕ ರಚನೆಗಳು ಬೇರೆಯವರಿಂದ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡಿಸುವ ಸನ್ನಿವೇಶಗಳನ್ನು ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. 'had her car repaired' = ಕಾರ್ ರಿಪೇರಿ ಮಾಡಿಸಿದಳು (ಮೆಕ್ಯಾನಿಕ್ ಮಾಡಿದ). 'made us write' = ನಮ್ಮನ್ನು ಬರೆಯುವಂತೆ ಮಾಡಿದ (ಒತ್ತಾಯ). 'let me use' = ಬಳಸಲು ಬಿಟ್ಟ (ಅನುಮತಿ).

examples: She had her phone repaired at the shop
I got my hair cut yesterday
We need to get the car serviced
The boss made us work overtime
My parents let me go to the party
The teacher made the students clean the classroom

objectives: Use 'have/get something done' for arranged services

content.explanation: Direct speech: exact words in quotes. 'She said, "I am tired."' Indirect speech: reported without quotes, tense shifts back. She said (that) she was tired. Commands: 'Close the door!' → He told me to close the door. Requests: 'Please help me.' → She asked me to help her. Questions: 'Are you coming?' → He asked if I was coming.
content.kannadaExplanation: ನೇರ ಮಾತು: ನಿಖರ ಪದಗಳು ಉಲ್ಲೇಖ ಚಿಹ್ನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ. ಪರೋಕ್ಷ: ಉಲ್ಲೇಖ ಇಲ್ಲ, ಕಾಲ ಹಿಂದಕ್ಕೆ. ಆಜ್ಞೆ: 'Close the door!' → told me to close. ವಿನಂತಿ: 'Please help' → asked me to help.

examples: 'I am happy' → He said he was happy
'I will come' → She said she would come
'I can help' → He said he could help
'Where do you live?' → She asked where I lived
'Are you happy?' → He asked if I was happy

objectives: Convert direct to indirect speech for statements
Practice all types of reported speech

lessons.title: Active vs Passive Voice - All Tenses

content.explanation: Active vs Passive Voice across all tenses: Present Simple: 'They clean the office.' → 'The office is cleaned.' Past Simple: 'She wrote the report.' → 'The report was written.' Present Perfect: 'They have finished it.' → 'It has been finished.' Future: 'They will announce the results.' → 'The results will be announced.' Present Continuous: 'They are building a bridge.' → 'A bridge is being built.'
content.kannadaExplanation: ಕರ್ತರಿ vs ಕರ್ಮಣಿ ಎಲ್ಲ ಕಾಲಗಳಲ್ಲಿ: ಸರಳ ವರ್ತಮಾನ: is/are + pp. ಸರಳ ಭೂತ: was/were + pp. ಪೂರ್ಣ ವರ್ತಮಾನ: has/have been + pp. ಭವಿಷ್ಯ: will be + pp. ನಿರಂತರ: is/are being + pp.
objectives: Convert active to passive in all major tenses
Choose when to use passive voice
Practice passive in formal and academic writing

content.explanation: Advanced Subject-Verb Agreement: Tricky cases — Collective nouns: 'The team is winning.' (single unit). 'The team are arguing among themselves.' (individuals, British English). Each/Every + singular: 'Every student has a book.' Neither/Either + singular: 'Neither option is good.' One of + plural noun + singular verb: 'One of my friends is a doctor.' There is/are depends on the noun after: 'There are many people.'
content.kannadaExplanation: ಕಷ್ಟ ಕರ್ತೃ-ಕ್ರಿಯಾಪದ ಒಪ್ಪಂದ: ಸಾಮೂಹಿಕ ನಾಮಪದ: 'The team is...' Each/Every + ಏಕವಚನ. Neither/Either + ಏಕವಚನ. 'One of my friends is...' (is, are ಅಲ್ಲ). 'There are many people.' (people = ಬಹುವಚನ).

examples: Either he or she is coming
Neither the boys nor the girl was late
Either you or I am wrong

objectives: Handle tricky SVA with collective nouns
Master 'one of' + plural noun + singular verb

content.explanation: 'Wish' and 'If only' express regrets and desires for things to be different. Present wish (things you want different NOW): 'I wish I had a car' (but I don't). Past wish/regret: 'I wish I had studied harder' (but I didn't). Future wish: 'I wish you would stop making noise.' 'If only' is stronger/more emotional: 'If only I could speak English fluently!' Same grammar as 'wish'.
content.kannadaExplanation: 'Wish' ಮತ್ತು 'If only' ವಿಷಾದ ಮತ್ತು ಆಸೆಗಳನ್ನು ವ್ಯಕ್ತಪಡಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ವರ್ತಮಾನ: 'I wish I had a car' (ಆದರೆ ಇಲ್ಲ). ಭೂತಕಾಲ: 'I wish I had studied harder' (ಆದರೆ ಓದಲಿಲ್ಲ). 'If only' ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಭಾವನಾತ್ಮಕ: 'If only I could speak English!' ವ್ಯಾಕರಣ 'wish' ನಂತೆಯೇ.

examples: I wish I had a better job
She wishes she could speak English fluently
I wish I lived closer to the office
I wish I had studied medicine
She wishes she hadn't left her previous job
If only I had saved more money when I was young

objectives: Use 'wish + past simple' for present wishes
Use 'wish + past perfect' for past regrets
Use 'wish + would' for complaints about others
Understand 'If only' as a stronger form of 'wish'

content.explanation: Punctuation: Period/Full stop (.) — end sentences. Comma (,) — lists, pauses, after introductions. Question mark (?) — questions. Exclamation mark (!) — strong emotion. Apostrophe (') — contractions (don't, isn't) and possession (Ramesh's book). Capitalization: First word, proper nouns (names, places, months, days, languages), I.

content.explanation: This lesson addresses the most common English errors made specifically by Kannada speakers. These errors come from transferring Kannada grammar rules into English. Key areas: missing articles (a/an/the), SOV word order, missing plural -s, using present continuous for states ('I am having a car'), confusing he/she/they (from ಅವರು), dropping prepositions, and common Indianisms.
content.kannadaExplanation: ಈ ಪಾಠ ಕನ್ನಡ ಮಾತನಾಡುವವರು ಮಾಡುವ ಅತಿ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಇಂಗ್ಲಿಷ್ ತಪ್ಪುಗಳನ್ನು ಪರಿಹರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಈ ತಪ್ಪುಗಳು ಕನ್ನಡ ವ್ಯಾಕರಣ ನಿಯಮಗಳನ್ನು ಇಂಗ್ಲಿಷ್‌ಗೆ ವರ್ಗಾಯಿಸುವುದರಿಂದ ಬರುತ್ತವೆ. ಪ್ರಮುಖ: articles ಮರೆಯುವುದು, SOV ಕ್ರಮ, ಬಹುವಚನ -s ಮರೆಯುವುದು, ಅವರು→he/she/they ಗೊಂದಲ.

examples: ✗ I am engineer → ✓ I am an engineer
✗ Give me book → ✓ Give me the book
✗ She is doctor → ✓ She is a doctor
✗ I temple go → ✓ I go to the temple
✗ She food cooked → ✓ She cooked food
✗ He book read → ✓ He read a book
✗ I am having a car → ✓ I have a car
✗ I am knowing him → ✓ I know him
✗ She is liking coffee → ✓ She likes coffee

objectives: Identify and fix the top 10 Kannada-English errors
Understand WHY these errors happen (Kannada grammar transfer)
Build awareness to self-correct while speaking

quiz.title: Common Kannada-English Errors Quiz
quiz.description: Test Common Kannada-English Errors

commonMistakes.mistake: I am having two brothers and one sister.
commonMistakes.correction: I have two brothers and one sister.
commonMistakes.explanation: 'have' (ಒಡೆತನ/ಸಂಬಂಧ) stative verb — continuous ರೂಪ ಬೇಡ. ಕನ್ನಡ: 'ನನಗೆ ಇದ್ದಾರೆ' → 'I have'.

commonMistakes.correction: Yesterday I went to the office.
commonMistakes.explanation: ಕನ್ನಡ SOV: ನಾನು ಕಚೇರಿಗೆ ಹೋದೆ. ಇಂಗ್ಲಿಷ್ SVO: I went to the office.

commonMistakes.mistake: I am engineer. I am working in Bengaluru.
commonMistakes.correction: I am an engineer. I work in Bengaluru.
commonMistakes.explanation: 1) ವೃತ್ತಿಗೆ 'a/an' ಬೇಕು. 2) ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಸತ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ present simple (work), continuous ಅಲ್ಲ.

commonMistakes.mistake: Ramesh told that he will come.
commonMistakes.correction: Ramesh said that he would come.
commonMistakes.explanation: 'tell' ನಂತರ ಯಾರಿಗೆ ಹೇಳಿದರು ಬೇಕು (told ME). Reported speech: will → would.

commonMistakes.mistake: I have a doubt about this topic.
commonMistakes.correction: I have a question about this topic.
commonMistakes.explanation: ಭಾರತೀಯ ಇಂಗ್ಲಿಷ್: 'doubt' = 'ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ'. ಅಂತರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ: 'doubt' = 'ಸಂಶಯ/ಅನುಮಾನ'. ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ ಕೇಳಲು 'question' ಬಳಸಿ.

commonMistakes.mistake: One of my friend is from Mysuru.
commonMistakes.correction: One of my friends is from Mysuru.
commonMistakes.explanation: 'One of my' ನಂತರ ಬಹುವಚನ: friends (ಅನೇಕರಲ್ಲಿ ಒಬ್ಬ).

commonMistakes.mistake: She is more better than him.
commonMistakes.correction: She is better than him.
commonMistakes.explanation: 'better' ಈಗಾಗಲೇ comparative. 'more' ಬೇಡ.

commonMistakes.correction: I didn't go to school.
commonMistakes.explanation: 'didn't' ನಂತರ ಮೂಲ ರೂಪ (go), ಭೂತಕಾಲ (went) ಅಲ್ಲ.

content.explanation: Fluent speaking skills go beyond grammar — it's about natural flow, filler words, and connected speech. Use natural fillers: 'Well...', 'Actually...', 'You know...', 'I mean...', 'Let me think...' Avoid Kannada fillers: 'ಅಂದರೆ', 'ಅದು', 'ಹಂಗಂದ್ರೆ' while speaking English. Practice: speak for 2 minutes about any topic without stopping. Record yourself and listen back.
content.kannadaExplanation: ನಿರರ್ಗಳ ಮಾತು ವ್ಯಾಕರಣಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು — ಸ್ವಾಭಾವಿಕ ಹರಿವು, ತುಂಬುಪದಗಳು ಮುಖ್ಯ. ಇಂಗ್ಲಿಷ್ ತುಂಬುಪದಗಳು: 'Well...', 'Actually...', 'You know...'. ಇಂಗ್ಲಿಷ್ ಮಾತನಾಡುವಾಗ ಕನ್ನಡ ತುಂಬುಪದಗಳನ್ನು ಬಳಸಬೇಡಿ.
objectives: Speak for 2+ minutes on any topic
Avoid mixing Kannada fillers while speaking English
Practice connected speech and natural rhythm

content.explanation: Expressing complex ideas: Use linking words to connect ideas. Cause/effect: 'due to', 'as a result', 'consequently'. Contrast: 'however', 'on the other hand', 'although'. Addition: 'furthermore', 'moreover', 'in addition'. Example: 'for instance', 'such as'. Conclusion: 'in conclusion', 'overall', 'to sum up'.
content.kannadaExplanation: ಸಂಕೀರ್ಣ ಆಲೋಚನೆ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಪಡಿಸುವುದು: ಸಂಪರ್ಕ ಪದಗಳು. ಕಾರಣ/ಪರಿಣಾಮ: 'due to', 'as a result'. ವೈರುಧ್ಯ: 'however', 'although'. ಸೇರ್ಪಡೆ: 'furthermore', 'moreover'. ಉದಾಹರಣೆ: 'for instance'. ತೀರ್ಮಾನ: 'in conclusion'.

examples: First, let me explain. Second, consider this. Finally, conclude

patterns.pattern: On one hand... on the other hand...
examples: On one hand it's good, on the other hand it's expensive

objectives: Use advanced linking words in speech

content.explanation: Debate skills: State your position: 'I believe that...' Support: 'My main argument is...' Evidence: 'Studies show...', 'According to...' Counter: 'Some people argue that..., however...' Refute: 'While that may be true, the evidence suggests...' Conclude: 'Therefore, I maintain that...' Stay respectful!
content.kannadaExplanation: ವಾದ ಕೌಶಲ: ನಿಲುವು: 'I believe that...' ಬೆಂಬಲ: 'My main argument is...' ಸಾಕ್ಷ್ಯ: 'Studies show...' ಎದುರು: 'Some people argue..., however...' ತೀರ್ಮಾನ: 'Therefore, I maintain that...' ಗೌರವ ಕಾಪಾಡಿ!

I respectfully disagree because the evidence suggests otherwise

content.explanation: Negotiation skills: Opening: 'I'd like to discuss...' Proposing: 'What if we...?' 'How about...?' Bargaining: 'If you can offer X, we can agree to Y.' Compromising: 'I understand your position. Let's find a middle ground.' Accepting: 'That sounds fair.' 'We have a deal.' Declining: 'I appreciate the offer, but...' 'That doesn't work for us.'

content.explanation: Small talk: Casual conversation with colleagues, acquaintances, at events. Topics: weather ('Nice weather today!'), weekends ('Did you do anything fun this weekend?'), sports ('Did you watch the match?'), food ('Have you tried the new restaurant?'). Avoid: salary, age, religion, politics (in professional settings). Keep it light and positive!
content.kannadaExplanation: ಸಣ್ಣ ಮಾತು: ಸಹೋದ್ಯೋಗಿಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ, ಸಮಾರಂಭಗಳಲ್ಲಿ. ವಿಷಯ: ಹವಾಮಾನ, ವಾರಾಂತ್ಯ, ಕ್ರೀಡೆ, ಆಹಾರ. ಬೇಡ: ಸಂಬಳ, ವಯಸ್ಸು, ಧರ್ಮ, ರಾಜಕೀಯ. ಹಗುರ ಮತ್ತು ಧನಾತ್ಮಕವಾಗಿರಿ!

examples: How do you like the weather?
How do you like this place?
Have you been to that restaurant?

objectives: Know appropriate topics for casual conversation
Avoid sensitive topics in professional settings

content.explanation: Cultural topics for conversation: Festivals (Dasara, Ugadi, Pongal, Diwali, Christmas), food culture (regional cuisines), traditions (wedding customs, family values), sports (cricket, kabaddi), Bollywood/Sandalwood movies, Indian vs Western work culture. Useful phrases: 'In our culture...', 'The tradition is to...', 'It's similar to...', 'Unlike in Western countries...'
content.kannadaExplanation: ಸಾಂಸ್ಕೃತಿಕ ವಿಷಯ: ಹಬ್ಬಗಳು (ದಸರಾ, ಉಗಾದಿ), ಆಹಾರ ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತಿ, ಸಂಪ್ರದಾಯ, ಕ್ರೀಡೆ, ಸಿನಿಮಾ. ಉಪಯುಕ್ತ: 'In our culture...' = ನಮ್ಮ ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ..., 'The tradition is to...' = ಸಂಪ್ರದಾಯ...

content.explanation: Discussing current affairs: Use present perfect for recent news: 'India has launched a new satellite.' Use passive for reports: 'A new policy has been announced.' Express views: 'I think...', 'In my opinion...' Vocabulary: government (ಸರ್ಕಾರ), economy (ಆರ್ಥಿಕತೆ), election (ಚುನಾವಣೆ), environment (ಪರಿಸರ), technology (ತಂತ್ರಜ್ಞಾನ), climate change (ಹವಾಮಾನ ಬದಲಾವಣೆ).
content.kannadaExplanation: ಪ್ರಚಲಿತ ವಿಷಯ ಚರ್ಚೆ: ಇತ್ತೀಚಿನ ಸುದ್ದಿಗೆ present perfect: 'India has launched...' ವರದಿಗೆ passive: 'A policy has been announced.' ಪದಗಳು: government=ಸರ್ಕಾರ, economy=ಆರ್ಥಿಕತೆ, environment=ಪರಿಸರ.
objectives: Discuss news and current events in English
Use present perfect and passive for news reporting
Use advanced vocabulary for current affairs

speakingPractice.english: I think the best way to learn English is through daily practice and conversation.
speakingPractice.kannada: ದೈನಂದಿನ ಅಭ್ಯಾಸ ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಭಾಷಣೆ ಇಂಗ್ಲಿಷ್ ಕಲಿಯಲು ಅತ್ಯುತ್ತಮ.
speakingPractice.transliteration: ai think dha best vey tu larn inglish iz throo deyli praektis aend kanvarseyshun

speakingPractice.english: Good morning everyone. Today I'd like to present our quarterly results.
speakingPractice.kannada: ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಶುಭ ಬೆಳಿಗ್ಗೆ. ತ್ರೈಮಾಸಿಕ ಫಲಿತಾಂಶ ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತಪಡಿಸುತ್ತೇನೆ.

speakingPractice.transliteration: ai straangli bileev teknaalaji aend ejukeyshn kaen traensform rooral karnaataka

speakingPractice.english: If you can reduce the timeline by two weeks, we can agree to the budget.
speakingPractice.kannada: ಎರಡು ವಾರ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಮಾಡಿದರೆ ಬಜೆಟ್‌ಗೆ ಒಪ್ಪಬಹುದು.
speakingPractice.transliteration: if yoo kaen ridyoos dha taimlain vee kaen agree tu dha bajit

speakingPractice.english: Congratulations! You have completed the entire English course. Keep practicing!
speakingPractice.kannada: ಅಭಿನಂದನೆ! ಇಡೀ ಇಂಗ್ಲಿಷ್ ಕೋರ್ಸ್ ಮುಗಿಸಿದ್ದೀರಿ. ಅಭ್ಯಾಸ ಮುಂದುವರೆಸಿ!
speakingPractice.transliteration: kangrachuleyshans! yoo haev kampletid dhi entaiar inglish kors. keep praektising!

speakingPractice.english: From 'Hello, my name is...' to giving presentations — what an incredible journey!
speakingPractice.kannada: 'Hello, my name is...' ನಿಂದ ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತಿ ನೀಡುವವರೆಗೆ — ಅದ್ಭುತ ಪ್ರಯಾಣ!
